defects.history_ref: e94c21a fix: restore null check on patient id after crash (#412)
defects.description: Removes the patient_id None guard that #412 restored after a crash on null patient ids. payload['patient'].get('id') returns None for kiosk offline payloads, so None now reaches find_by_id unchecked and the crash returns. The stated premise is false: parse_payload only checks that a 'patient' key exists, not that its id is set.
